cues: The height of the hill above the reactants is the activation energy, E a: the extra energy a collision must bring.
The absolute height it must reach is the threshold energy.
A small activation energy means a fast reaction.
A large one means a slow one.
The difference between reactants and products is delta H, which has nothing to do with the hill.
